title: ModelManifest
description: VENDORED from SourceOS-Linux/sourceos-spec (Tranche 7, canonical owner). Content-addressed store manifest for a base model in the Model Plane store (Tranche 7, T7-2). Sits at /var/lib/sourceos/models/base/sha256-<digest>/manifest.json and describes the weights at rest: architecture, quantization, tokenizer digest, format, and the detached signature. Distinct from SourceOSModelCarryRef (a governance/carry *reference* with policy, which points AT a manifest digest) and from ArtifactManifest/PackageManifest (generic artifacts). No model loads without signature verification (SEAM-014), so a valid manifest MUST carry signature info; and it MUST declare a license so the MIT/Apache-only estate rule is checkable before wiring.

specVersion.description: Spec version of this document, e.g. "2.1.0".

modelDigest.description: Content address of the model weights — the directory key in the content-addressed store.

architecture.description: Model architecture family, e.g. llama, qwen2, gemma2, phi3.

parameterCount.description: Approximate parameter count, or null when unknown.

quantization.description: Quantization/precision label, e.g. q4_k_m, q2_k, int8, mixed-2-4bit, bf16.

tokenizerDigest.description: Content-addressed digest of the tokenizer, or null when the tokenizer is embedded in the weights.

contextLength.description: Maximum context length in tokens, or null when unknown.

defaultTier.description: The Model Plane tier this model is normally resident at.

modalities.description: Modalities the model serves. When present, at least one, no duplicates.

license.description: SPDX license identifier for the model weights, e.g. "Apache-2.0", "MIT". Required so the estate's MIT/Apache-only rule can be enforced before a model is wired; use "LicenseRef-<name>" for non-SPDX licenses (e.g. LicenseRef-Gemma, LicenseRef-Llama-Community), which are NOT MIT/Apache and must be flagged.

signature.description: Detached-signature descriptor. Required — no model loads without signature verification against the trust store (SEAM-014).

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm, e.g. ed25519, ecdsa-p256, rsa-pss-sha256.

keyId.description: Trust-store key identifier that must verify this signature.

signatureDigest.description: Digest of the detached signature blob (signature.sig) stored beside the manifest.

carryRefs.description: Optional back-links to SourceOSModelCarryRef URNs that carry this model.

evidenceRefs.description: Evidence URNs or content hashes for provenance, checksums, and quantization procedure.
